<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/v1/containers/stats"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns one sample of CPU, memory, network I/O, block I/O and PIDs for supervised
containers (cgroup v2 when available, otherwise `/proc`). The handler waits
`interval_ms` between two samples so `cpu_percent` is meaningful.
Used by `nyx stats` and `nyx compose stats` (the CLI polls this endpoint).
